# Luis Alberto Duarte Cortés — Systems Engineer & Automation

## About
Luis Alberto Duarte Cortés is a Systems Engineer from Bogotá, Colombia specializing in automation workflows, REST API integrations, Python scripting, and AI-assisted tooling. C1 English (IELTS Academic 7.0, British Council). Remote-ready for US and LATAM timezones.

Graduated with a Meritorious Thesis from Universidad ECCI (B.Sc. Systems Engineering, 2024). The thesis — an open-source voice-recognition accessibility tool for hearing-impaired users — was adopted by SENA Regional Amazonas and Universidad ECCI. Speaker on cybersecurity and AI security topics in Bogotá (2025, 2026).

## Speaking

- Cybersecurity Forum, Bogotá (2025): Panelist on network security and infrastructure.
